fields.label: Application PDF
fields.description: Upload the applicant's application form / transcript / certificate as a PDF. Re-upload to replace and re-extract.

fields.label: Supporting Document (optional)
fields.description: Optional second PDF (e.g. a separate English test certificate) if the primary document doesn't cover everything. Not a child table by design — upload one combined PDF where possible.

fields.label: Extraction Status
fields.options:
Not Extracted
Extracted
Extraction Failed
Manually Entered
fields.description: Set by the Client Script. 'Manually Entered' is set automatically if staff edit any applicant field after extraction (or type values in directly without running extraction).

fields.label: Extracted JSON (raw AI output)
fields.description: Raw JSON returned by the vision model on Extract from PDF, kept for audit/review. Not used by the rules engine directly — the rules engine reads the editable fields below, which staff can correct after extraction.

fields.options: Fields below are filled by Extract from PDF and are fully editable. Review and correct every value before clicking Run Assessment — nothing is assessed on unverified AI output.

fields.label: Age
fields.description: Computed by the Client Script from Date of Birth when Run Assessment is clicked.

fields.label: Program Applied
fields.description: Plain text, not a Link — AI-extracted text will not always match an existing Program record exactly. Switch to Link→Program later if you want strict validation.

fields.label: Course Type
fields.description: Plain text. The Client Script's extraction prompt should steer this toward one of the controlled course-type names used in COURSE_TYPE_KEY_MAP (see mer_rules.skeleton.js) so the rules engine can match it.

fields.label: Recommendation
fields.options:
Eligible
Not Eligible
Conditional – English Placement Required
Requires Interview
Requires Additional Documents
Manual Review

fields.label: Proposed Alternative
fields.description: Fallback/lower/foundation course suggested when the applicant does not meet MER. Plain text (e.g. an internal pathway note), not restricted to a Program record, since the alternative may not always be a formal Program.

fields.label: Assessment Detail (JSON)
fields.description: Machine-readable reasons/flags from the rules engine (and AI supporting evidence, if enabled).

fields.label: Staff Override Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes for staff who manually override or annotate the automated recommendation.
